**sdd/issue-231-a2/spec**

A2 (#231) spec deltas. REQ-A2-1: brain ships gitlab-governance.yml as opt-in fragment (managed-paths literal), consumer root .gitlab-ci.yml stays LOCAL; job names == GOVERNANCE_JOBS. REQ-A2-2: issue-link+diff-size run through Node (run-check.mjs) fed by ci-context, never bash-on-GitLab; size:exception and referenced-issue approved-label read from FRESH ctx.labels not frozen CI_MERGE_REQUEST_LABELS; null body fails REQUIRED gate closed. REQ-A2-3: governance.approvedLabel additive config, resolver returns status:approved (GitHub)/status::approved (GitLab); no runtime hardcodes status:approved after slice. REQ-A2-4: REQUIRED jobs normal (block), DETECTION jobs allow_failure:true; classes never flatten. REQ-A2-5: drift-guard string-slices GitLab YAML (no yaml dep), asserts job-set==GOVERNANCE_JOBS + allow_failure iff DETECTION_JOBS. Full artifact at openspec/changes/issue-231-a2/spec.md.
